about_the_game:
Arcana Academy is a magic-themed card simulation management game, with many mysteries waiting to be discovered. In the game, you will act as a Mage Headmaster, freely constructing your magical Academy, summoning and nurturing students of different races to support the empire's reconstruction.

If you could freely construct and develop your magical academy, would you choose to teach students or nurture monsters?

Freely construct your magical academy, from regular classrooms to mage towers. Those enrolling might be ordinary humans, beautiful elves, or rebellious vampires. Cultivate different races, unleash their potential, but also be wary of those with poor self-control.

The mysterious summoning ritual for students, what results will the ritual lead to if demon blood is mixed in?

Add your favorite materials to the ritual, with offerings that can be food, animals, or coins. The correct execution of the ritual usually requires fixed offerings, and the results are generally consistent; however, if you play against the rules, the results might lead to the unknown...

Customize your various Academies, from names to teaching philosophies, whether to develop comprehensively or specialize in one area?

Each academy's name and emblem can be freely defined. Add students to the Academy, formulate suitable study plans for them, help them comprehend the mysteries of elements, or study more effective production methods. Ultimately becoming a genius... or falling into mediocrity.

When faced with powerful enemy invasions, will you choose to fight together or offer some sacrifices to temporarily ease the crisis?

During your school-building process, monsters will constantly covet you. To ensure peace and stability for your Academy, besides sending people to resolve them, you can also offer some protection fees in exchange for more development opportunities.

The continuously unlocking new magic and technology, will it help you create legends or trigger more disasters and crises?

In the process of expanding the Academy, you will encounter many new knowledge and magic, mastering more technology to rapidly develop your Academy. But continuous development is a double-edged sword, potentially bringing more crises along with it, so be sure to prepare for them.

short_description: Build your magic academy in this card realm. Recruit students, manage their tasks or classes, perform rituals, and explore a perilous magical world. Faced with the encroachment of the Abyss, can you live up to people's expectations and save the empire from crisis?
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Russian, Japanese, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
